DEVELOPMENT UPDATE

3.3 · Build 93

October 25, 2026

More browsers, one protected list.

  • Chrome, Edge and Firefox testing packages now follow the Mac app’s website list.
  • The Chrome preview was checked live: a Mac timer blocked an already-open distracting page, and the website became available after the diagnostic ended.
  • Edge and Firefox packages passed the shared automated checks; real-browser acceptance testing is still pending.

A steadier start.

Safari startup now retries temporary connection failures, has a bounded timeout, and shows a useful error if protection cannot connect. Stale backup extension registration was removed from the tested installation.

A little more presence.

The three-bar mark is larger inside the Mac Dock icon.

Local by design.

The new extensions receive only selected domains and expiring protection state through a local, read-only connection. Browsing addresses are not sent to the Mac app or a server.

These are development previews for invited Mac testers. Public app downloads and browser-store listings are not available yet. Firefox’s temporary package is removed after a browser restart; permanent distribution needs Mozilla signing.

PREVIOUS DEVELOPMENT UPDATE

3.3 · Build 82

October 24, 2026

A clearer picture of your progress

  • Switch daily focus and hourly study-rhythm charts between green totals and coloured course segments.
  • Explore course shares and daily or hourly breakdowns.
  • Export selected entries, daily totals by course or full saved history as CSV.

A consistent identity

The Superfocus logo keeps the same size as the regular header, without an added box. Its red accent remains.

Current development features

The standalone Mac preview includes timers, stopwatch, Superfocus, local history, analytics and the bundled Safari extension. It targets Apple silicon Macs on macOS 14 or later. It does not include the iCloud provisioning used by the separate companion development builds.

Development status

Public downloads are not available on this website yet. The current build is a development version, and distribution details will be confirmed before release.

Browser availability

Safari is bundled. Chrome, Edge and Firefox extension listings are not available yet.

See downloads →

Companion development

iPhone and iPad build 23 adds shared pause, resume and end controls for regular sessions, regardless of the starter. Superfocus retains its commitment lock. These companion builds and iCloud sync are not offered as public downloads here.

Make the time count.
